# vera

36, Bilbao. Runs four mornings a week - three on the river path, one on a
forest loop above the city - and records every one of them twice without
meaning to. The watch is on her wrist; the phone rides in a vest pocket
because she wants the camera. Both log the run.

## Why she exists

`comparability` is the dataset that holds a MEASURED overlap between two
instruments, and until this record nothing in the corpus wrote one. The engine
could express the statement and no record made it, so anything resting on that
evidence would have shipped with nothing to rest on.

She is the overlap. A hundred-odd runs where two instruments measured the same
metres, and a disagreement with a shape worth keeping:

- on the open river path they land within a few tens of metres of each other;
- under the canopy on the forest loop the phone loses fix and reads short, by
  a few hundred metres to over a kilometre;
- so the two agree on average and disagree on any given run, and the range
  runs much further one way than the other.

Nothing in her record corrects anything. She wrote down what she measured and
left both readings alone.
